I really appreciate your help—I’m just trying to get things sorted out.

I’m sorry you’re dealing with all of this—yes, I can help you sort it out.

First, I’ll need to authenticate your account so I can look up your orders and check which ones are **pending** (cancelable) vs **delivered** (returnable).

Please reply with **one** of the following:
1) **Your email address**, or  
2) **Your first name + last name + ZIP code**

Once I find your account, I can list your recent orders with their current status and tell you what can still be cancelled or returned.

Thank you so much for understanding. I really appreciate your patience with me—I know I’m probably not the only one going through something like this, but it’s just been a lot lately.

My email is silva7872@example.com. Let me know if you need anything else to pull up my account.
